Cube Storage Pioneers

Little Robots, Big Business

Since its inception in 1996, AutoStore™ has worked to improve warehouse efficiency. Today, the company’s key value proposition is to deliver an easy-to-use software powered cubic automatic storage and retrieval ecosystem.

The AutoStore solution is modular and flexible, and can automate any warehouse. The system offers a superior customer value proposition across operating metrics, ESG scores, and customer economics.
‍

elements.title: Charles J. M. Gwinn (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Charles J. M. Gwinn (pictured) was the first state's attorney of Baltimore elected under the Maryland Constitution of 1851, which he had helped to draft?

elements.title: Every Night (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that "Every Night" was called "the smartest dumb music out there"?

elements.title: Sixth National Eucharistic Congress (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Bishop John Dunn continued to celebrate Mass after a fire broke out in the choir loft of St. Cecilia Cathedral during the Sixth National Eucharistic Congress?

elements.title: Florentina Holzinger (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that over the opening weekend of Florentina Holzinger's first opera, eighteen audience members required medical treatment for severe nausea?

elements.title: apricot dress of Jacqueline Kennedy (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the apricot dress of Jacqueline Kennedy kept its shape in India's hot weather?

elements.title: Oun Yao-ling (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that weightlifter Oun Yao-ling was asked to compete in the South African Games, but the invitation was swiftly rescinded once the organisers learned that he was Chinese, not white?

elements.title: Salmon n' Bannock (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the opening of Salmon n' Bannock led to the owner reconnecting with her long-lost family?

elements.title: Czarodziejski okręt (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Władysław Umiński's 1914 novel Czarodziejski okręt was described as being a "grotesque" treatment of the robinsonade?

elements.title: Ross Mihara (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Ross Mihara "didn't know a yorikiri from hara-kiri" when he was hired as a sumo commentator by NHK?
